shellCommands.command: find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html' 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- shell contents ---"; for f in $(find .next -path '*product*' -name '*.html' 2>/dev/null); do echo "== $f"; grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Loading inventory\|in stock' "$f" | sort -u; done

cp app/product/page.tsx /tmp/fixed.tsx cat > app/product/page.tsx <<'EOF' import { getInventory } from '@/lib/data' export default async function ProductPage() { const inventory = await getInventory() return (

Premium Widget

{inventory.count} in stock

Price: ${inventory.price}

) } EOF npx next build 2>&1 | grep -A6 'Route (app)' echo "=== does a product shell exist? ===" ls .next/server/app/product.html 2>&1 || echo "NO static shell for /product" cp /tmp/fixed.tsx app/product/page.tsx
